1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SubdivisionHinges
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.ContractedHinges
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralAllPairs
4 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralReassembly
5 
6 /-! A consistent selected subdivision gives a certificate on rigid, whole original facets. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
9 
10 open OctahedralTriangles OctahedralNet
11 
12 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
13 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
14   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
15 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
16 
17 /-- After whole-facet consistency is checked, no rigidity, hinge, tree, or nonoverlap obligation remains. -/
18 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding_of_consistent_subdivision
19     (source_order : graph.curvature (opposite source) ≤ graph.curvature source)
20     (maximal : ∀ i, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source i) ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit))
21     (consistent : ∀ x y : FaceIndex, graph.netFace small_faces source slit x = graph.netFace small_faces source slit y →
22       Set.EqOn (net.place x) (net.place y) (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y).val) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
23   classical
24   let face := graph.netFace small_faces source slit
25   have onto := graph.netFace_surjective_all small_faces source slit
26   choose representative at_face using onto
27   let placement (F : P.Face) := net.place (representative F)
28   have agree (i : FaceIndex) : Set.EqOn (placement (face i)) (net.place i) (face i).val :=
29     consistent (representative (face i)) i (at_face (face i))
30   have rigid (F : P.Face) : ∀ x ∈ F.val, ∀ y ∈ F.val,
31       dist (placement F x) (placement F y) = dist x y := by
32     have proof := net.rigid_netFace (representative F)
33     rw [at_face F] at proof
34     exact proof
35   have connected := contractedHinges_connected OctahedralNet.hinges face OctahedralNet.connected
36     (graph.netFace_surjective_all small_faces source slit)
37   obtain ⟨hinges, retained, tree⟩ := connected.exists_isTree_le
38   apply graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_subdivision small_faces placement hinges tree
39   · intro F G edge
40     obtain ⟨different, x, y, original, rfl, rfl⟩ := retained edge
41     exact (net.original_subdivision_hinge x y original different).1
42   · exact rigid
43   · intro F G edge p member
44     obtain ⟨different, x, y, original, rfl, rfl⟩ := retained edge
45     exact (agree x member.1).trans
46       (((net.original_subdivision_hinge x y original different).2 member).trans (agree y member.2).symm)
47   · have placed (i : FaceIndex) : placement (face i) '' graph.triangle (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit i) =
48         net.placedTriangle i :=
49       ((agree i).mono (graph.triangle_subset_face small_faces _)).image_eq
50     intro t u different
51     obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (triangle_bijective source slit).2 t
52     obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (triangle_bijective source slit).2 u
53     change Disjoint (interior (placement (face i) '' graph.triangle (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit i)))
54       (interior (placement (face j) '' graph.triangle (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit j)))
55     rw [placed, placed]
56     exact net.selected_triangles_nonoverlap source_order maximal i j (fun same => different (same ▸ rfl))
57 
58 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
